title: The Angels And Pure Spirits The Concordance Of Their Reports

questions.question: What did the traveler want to grow stronger in himself?
questions.answer: He wanted his faith to become stronger and his knowledge of Allah to increase.

questions.question: According to the passage, what is the greatest source of human excellence?
questions.answer: It is loving Allah, which comes from believing in Him and knowing Him.

questions.question: When the traveler looked up, where did he turn his attention?
questions.answer: He turned his attention to the heavens.

questions.question: In the traveler’s thinking, what is the most valuable thing in the universe?
questions.answer: Life is the most valuable thing.

questions.question: Among living things, which group does the passage say is most precious?
questions.answer: Those that are aware and conscious are the most precious.

questions.question: Why did the traveler think the heavens must have living and aware beings in them?
questions.answer: Because life and consciousness are so precious, he thought the great heavens would not be empty of such beings.

questions.question: What example is given to show that heavenly beings have appeared to people?
questions.answer: Jibril appeared to Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him, and was also seen by the Companions.

questions.question: Why did the traveler want to speak with the dwellers of the heavens?
questions.answer: He wanted to learn what they say about the Creator.

questions.question: Who answered the traveler?
questions.answer: A voice from the heavens answered him.

questions.question: What did that voice say the angels believed first?
questions.answer: They said they first believed in the truths of faith brought to the prophets, especially through Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him.

questions.question: Which book is specially mentioned in the angels’ message?
questions.answer: The Qur’an is specially mentioned.

questions.question: Besides angels, what other group from among them is mentioned as appearing before people?
questions.answer: Pure spirits are mentioned.

questions.question: What three things did these heavenly beings witness about Allah?
questions.answer: They witnessed His necessary existence, His oneness, and His holy attributes.

questions.question: What made their witness a strong guide for the traveler?
questions.answer: Their many messages matched one another and agreed together.

questions.question: What happened to the traveler’s faith after hearing this lesson?
questions.answer: His faith became brighter and rose upward.

questions.question: After learning from the angels, what did the traveler want to study next?
questions.answer: He wanted to explore the unseen world and the middle realm to search for reality.

questions.question: What gate opened to him after that?
questions.answer: The gate of straight, enlightened minds and sound, bright hearts opened to him.

questions.question: How are human minds and hearts described in relation to the universe?
questions.answer: They are described like a small seed that can spread wide enough to take in the whole universe.

questions.question: What moved the traveler to continue his journey for stronger faith?
questions.answer: He knew that the highest good in people comes from loving Allah through belief and knowledge, so he wanted to go farther.

questions.question: What did he use, inside and outside, to seek more faith?
questions.answer: He used all his powers, both inward and outward.

questions.question: What did he do before he began thinking about the heavens?
questions.answer: He lifted his head and looked upward.

questions.question: How does the passage rank life, living creatures, and conscious beings?
questions.answer: It says life is most precious, then living creatures, and among them the conscious are the most precious.

questions.question: What yearly and century-by-century process of the earth is mentioned?
questions.answer: The earth is described as being emptied and filled again and again.

questions.question: Why is that process important in the traveler’s argument?
questions.answer: It shows that precious life keeps being increased, so he reasons the heavens should also have living beings.

questions.question: What qualities did the traveler think the inhabitants of heaven would have?
questions.answer: He thought they would have life, spirit, and awareness.

questions.question: Which event connected with Jibril supports this idea?
questions.answer: Jibril’s appearance before the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, and before his Companions supports it.

questions.question: What did the traveler especially want to know from the people of heaven?
questions.answer: He wanted to know their words about the One who created everything.

questions.question: In the answer from heaven, who is mentioned first among the prophets?
questions.answer: Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him, is mentioned first.

questions.question: What had been brought through the angels to the prophets?
questions.answer: The teachings and truths of faith had been brought through them.

questions.question: How complete was the agreement of the pure spirits in their witness?
questions.answer: Their witness was total, with no exception.

questions.question: What does the passage say they announced together?
questions.answer: They announced Allah’s necessary existence, His oneness, and His pure attributes.

questions.question: What comparison is used for the guidance given by their matching messages?
questions.answer: It is compared to something as bright as the sun.

questions.question: What change took place in the traveler after this heavenly lesson?
questions.answer: The light of faith in him grew brighter and rose from earth toward the heavens.

questions.question: What two worlds did the traveler then wish to explore?
questions.answer: He wished to explore the unseen world and the intermediate realm.

questions.question: What was he trying to investigate by doing that?
questions.answer: He was trying to investigate what is truly real.

questions.question: What do enlightened minds and sound hearts show about a human being?
questions.answer: They show that even though a person may seem small, the inner human side can reach out to the whole universe.

questions.question: What does the passage say all human perfections come from at their root?
questions.answer: They come from loving Allah, which grows from faith and knowledge of Him.

questions.question: What did the traveler hope to develop more: his body or his faith and knowledge?
questions.answer: He hoped to develop his faith and knowledge more.

questions.question: What part of creation did he study next for answers?
questions.answer: He studied the heavens.

questions.question: Why does the traveler treat life as so important?
questions.answer: Because he sees all things serving life, which shows its great value.

questions.question: What is even more special than simply being alive, according to the passage?
questions.answer: Being conscious and aware is more special.

questions.question: What does the earth’s repeating cycle suggest to the traveler?
questions.answer: It suggests that increasing life is important in creation.

questions.question: From that idea, what conclusion does he draw about the heavens?
questions.answer: He concludes that the heavens should have living, spiritual, conscious inhabitants.

questions.question: Which well-known heavenly messenger is named as proof that angels are real?
questions.answer: Jibril, peace be upon him, is named.

questions.question: Why are the words of heavenly beings important to the traveler?
questions.answer: Because he thinks their testimony about the Creator matters greatly.

questions.question: What invitation did the heavenly voice give him?
questions.answer: It invited him to listen to their lesson if he wanted to meet them.

questions.question: What was the first part of that lesson?
questions.answer: The first part was that they believed in the truths sent to the prophets through them.

questions.question: What honor is given to Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him, in that message?
questions.answer: He is placed at the head among the prophets mentioned there.

questions.question: What did the pure spirits do when they appeared to human beings?
questions.answer: They gave witness together to Allah’s existence, oneness, and holy qualities.

questions.question: What makes their witness trustworthy in the passage?
questions.answer: Their reports agree with one another and support one another.

questions.question: How did this lesson affect the traveler’s spiritual condition?
questions.answer: It increased the brightness of his faith.

questions.question: After the lesson of the angels, what new journey did he seek?
questions.answer: He sought a journey through the unseen and the middle realm.

questions.question: What opened to him for this next journey?
questions.answer: The way of upright minds and shining hearts opened to him.

questions.question: How are those minds and hearts both small and great at the same time?
questions.answer: They may seem small in size, but they can grow in meaning until they hold the whole universe in understanding.

questions.question: What did the traveler already understand before looking to the heavens?
questions.answer: He understood that loving Allah, based on faith and knowing Him, is the highest human good.

questions.question: What does this show about the traveler’s goal?
questions.answer: It shows he wanted nearness to truth, stronger faith, and deeper knowledge of Allah.

questions.question: What action showed he was searching above the earth?
questions.answer: He raised his head toward the sky.

questions.question: What does the passage say everything is made to support?
questions.answer: Everything is made to support life.

questions.question: Which is higher in rank in the passage: living things or conscious beings?
questions.answer: Conscious beings are ranked higher.

questions.question: What ongoing change on earth is used as evidence in the traveler’s thinking?
questions.answer: The earth keeps losing and receiving creatures over time.

questions.question: What did this lead him to think about the heavens?
questions.answer: It led him to think the heavens must also contain beings with life and awareness.

questions.question: What historical kind of report helped support that belief?
questions.answer: Reports of angels being seen and speaking with people helped support it.

questions.question: Which meeting with Jibril is mentioned?
questions.answer: His appearing to the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, and to the Companions is mentioned.

questions.question: What subject did the traveler most want to ask heavenly beings about?
questions.answer: He wanted to ask about the Maker of the universe.

questions.question: Who spoke to him while he was thinking?
questions.answer: A voice from heaven spoke to him.

questions.question: What did that voice say about their own faith?
questions.answer: They said they had believed in the teachings sent to the prophets through them.

questions.question: How are the pure spirits described in their witness?
questions.answer: They are described as all agreeing without any exception.

questions.question: Name one thing, besides Allah’s oneness, that they testified to.
questions.answer: They testified to His necessary existence or His sacred attributes.

questions.question: Why is their agreement compared to sunlight?
questions.answer: Because their matching witness gives very clear guidance.

questions.question: What result came to the traveler after hearing them?
questions.answer: His faith became more radiant and lifted higher.

questions.question: Where did he want to travel after that?
questions.answer: He wanted to travel through the unseen world and the intermediate realm.

questions.question: What kind of inner human qualities were opened to him for that search?
questions.answer: Clear minds and sound, illuminated hearts were opened to him.

questions.question: What feeling toward Allah is called the source of all human excellences?
questions.answer: Love for Allah is called the source.

questions.question: What two things give rise to that love?
questions.answer: Belief in Allah and knowledge of Allah give rise to it.

questions.question: What did the traveler want to push forward in after understanding this?
questions.answer: He wanted to go farther in strengthening faith and increasing knowledge.

questions.question: What part of the universe did he examine for signs next?
questions.answer: He examined the heavens.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the value of life?
questions.answer: It describes life as the most precious thing in the universe.

questions.question: What makes some living beings more precious than others in the passage?
questions.answer: Their consciousness makes them more precious.

questions.question: How does the earth’s constant refilling support the traveler’s thought?
questions.answer: It shows that creation keeps producing life because life is highly valued.

questions.question: What conclusion did he make about the sky because of that?
questions.answer: He concluded that the sky should have living, spiritual, conscious inhabitants too.

questions.question: What example from prophetic history is used to support the presence of angels?
questions.answer: The example of Jibril appearing before the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, and the Companions.

questions.question: Why were the inhabitants of heaven especially important witnesses to him?
questions.answer: Because what they say about the Creator is very important.

questions.question: What did the heavenly voice tell him to do if he wanted their lesson?
questions.answer: It told him to know what they believed and what they testified to.

questions.question: What had the angels accepted before all others?
questions.answer: They had accepted the articles of faith brought to the prophets through them.

questions.question: Which prophet is singled out in their speech?
questions.answer: Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him.

questions.question: What did all the pure spirits agree to announce?
questions.answer: They agreed to announce Allah’s necessary existence, His unity, and His sacred attributes.

questions.question: What feature of their messages made them a powerful proof?
questions.answer: Their messages were in harmony with each other.

questions.question: What happened to the traveler’s faith after hearing this harmony?
questions.answer: It shone more brightly.

questions.question: What did he desire after learning from the heavenly beings?
questions.answer: He desired to study the unseen world and the intermediate realm.

questions.question: What comparison is made about human minds and hearts at the end of the passage?
questions.answer: They are compared to a seed that can grow wide enough to embrace the universe.

questions.question: What did the traveler believe was the highest and most important perfection for a person?
questions.answer: He believed it was loving Allah.

questions.question: According to the passage, where does that love begin?
questions.answer: It begins from faith in Allah and knowing Allah.

questions.question: What shows the traveler was very serious about growing in faith?
questions.answer: He wanted to advance with all his outer and inner powers.

questions.question: What direction did he look when seeking another lesson?
questions.answer: He looked toward the heavens.

questions.question: What does the passage say all things are placed under?
questions.answer: They are placed under life, serving it.

questions.question: Which is presented as the finest group among living things?
questions.answer: The conscious and aware are presented as the finest group.

questions.question: What repeating action of the globe is mentioned?
questions.answer: The globe is said to empty and fill itself again and again.

questions.question: What idea did the traveler build from that observation?
questions.answer: He built the idea that the heavens should also contain living, spiritual, aware beings.

questions.question: What report about angels is named in support of this idea?
questions.answer: The report that Jibril appeared to the Prophet, peace and blessings be upon him, and the Companions.

questions.question: What did the traveler wish he could do with the beings of heaven?
questions.answer: He wished he could speak with them.

questions.question: Why did he want to hear from them?
questions.answer: Because he wanted to know their testimony about the Creator of the universe.

questions.question: What did the heavenly voice say came through the angels to the prophets?
questions.answer: The truths and teachings of faith came through them.

questions.question: Which revealed book is connected with Prophet Muhammad, peace and blessings be upon him, in this lesson?
questions.answer: The Qur’an.

questions.question: What three parts of belief did the pure spirits testify to?
questions.answer: Allah’s necessary existence, His unity, and His sacred attributes.

questions.question: What can we infer from the fact that their messages match?
questions.answer: We can infer that their testimony is trustworthy and clear.

questions.question: What image is used to describe how clear their guidance is?
questions.answer: It is described as bright like the sun.

questions.question: After this, what two realms did the traveler want to investigate?
questions.answer: He wanted to investigate the unseen world and the intermediate realm.

questions.question: What inner human faculties opened before him at the end of the target passage?
questions.answer: Upright enlightened intellects and sound illuminated hearts opened before him.
